data.close_reason: The sys.path leak the ticket describes was removed in 1b8c50e3c23, and the failure reproduces without the hardening module. It comes from pytest 9.1.1 dropping a parent conftest's autouse fixtures for nested tests when explicit path arguments are ordered reconciler file, outside file, nested file (bare-pytest repro in the ticket comments). make test's default collection passed 3 of 3 runs, so CI is not exposed. No rebar change addresses it.
